scenes.narration: The orders route counts each caller's requests in one minute windows. Past twenty in a window, the limiter answers too many requests instead of creating the order.
scenes.summary: A Redis counter per IP and minute caps POST /orders at twenty requests.
bullets: Each IP gets one counter per one-minute window
The counter expires with its window
Past twenty, the route answers 429 with Retry-After

scenes.title: POST /orders
scenes.narration: A request reaches the Express API, which asks Redis to count it. Under the limit the orders service runs. Over the limit the API answers right away.
The rate limit function builds a key from the caller's address and the current window, then counts the request. Past twenty it sets the retry after header and answers four twenty-nine.
scenes.calloutText: The key changes every window, so old counters simply expire.
